summary: Auto-wah: a resonant low-pass whose cutoff a sine LFO sweeps, with cutoff, resonance, LFO rate, depth, settable LFO phase and a cutoff inertia. Mono, one track. For funky, talking filter movement; Neo Filter has an LFO of its own.
use_for: Auto-wah: a resonant low-pass swept by an LFO, for funky, talking filter movement.
quirks: Mono, one track: NeoBuzz Live feeds it left + right summed. Hot: +10 dB at its defaults on the profile's test signal, +3.5 dBFS peak.
Cutoff is 264 Hz x 32^(v/240): 264 Hz to 8.4 kHz, a step is 1/48 of an octave; LFO depth is in those steps (plus or minus half the value).
Resonance gives a Q from 1.01 to about 6 and the Theviderness factor attribute (0 by default) scales it down at low cutoffs.
Inertia glides the cutoff by 10 x (1 - v / 240) steps per 64 samples: 240 stops it moving at all.
Set LFO phase only sets a position when it is written; the LFO starts at 0.

track_parameters.name: Cutoff
track_parameters.description: Cutoff before the LFO: 264 Hz x 32^(v/240), 264 Hz to 8.4 kHz; a step is 1/48 of an octave (a bare 0 to 240 scale in the manifest).
track_parameters.how: Sets the filter's cutoff before the LFO: 264 Hz x 32^(v/240), 264 Hz to 8.4 kHz in 240 steps.
track_parameters.sound: Low values give a dark, muffled sound; high values open it up. The LFO swings around this point.

track_parameters.name: Resonance
track_parameters.how: Sets the filter's resonance on a 0 to 240 scale (a Q from about 1 to 6); A machine attribute, Theviderness factor (0 by default), can scale resonance down at low cutoffs; at 0 it does nothing.
track_parameters.sound: More resonance gives a sharper, more vocal peak at the cutoff; too much rings and gets loud.

track_parameters.name: LFO rate
track_parameters.how: Sets the LFO speed from 0.05 Hz to 27 Hz in an exponential scale.
track_parameters.sound: Slow rates give a long filter breathing; fast ones turn the sweep into a warble.

track_parameters.name: Modulation
track_parameters.how: Sets how far the LFO moves the cutoff: it swings plus or minus half this many steps, each step 1/48 of an octave, so 240 is plus or minus 2.5 octaves.
track_parameters.sound: Low values give a gentle wobble; high values give a wide, obvious wah sweep. At 0 the cutoff stays where Cutoff puts it.

track_parameters.name: Set phase
track_parameters.description: Writing it sets the LFO's position in its cycle: 2 pi x v / 128, up to 357 degrees (255 = not written).
track_parameters.how: Writing a value sets the LFO's position in its cycle: 2 pi x v / 128, 0 to 357 degrees (255 means not written).
track_parameters.sound: Use it to start the sweep from the same place on every bar.

track_parameters.name: Inertia
track_parameters.how: Sets how slowly the cutoff chases its target, 0 to 240: higher values glide more slowly (about 10 x (1 - v / 240) cutoff steps per 64 samples).
track_parameters.sound: Low values follow the LFO exactly; high values round off the sweep and smooth out jumps.
